policy.landings: Always localize hero + key sections for hi/ar/vi/zh/sw/fr/pt (native copy).
policy.seoArticles: Localize high-intent articles for priority markets first (hi, ar, vi, zh). Secondary locales may keep English until demand justifies translation.
policy.legal: English source of truth; translate only when counsel-reviewed.
policy.autoDetect: Browser language + regionHints; never force if user set tasteiq_locale_pref

steps: Write English article under articles/ (or journeys/) with stable slug
Add SEO meta + canonical + hreflang stubs in frontmatter key file
Generate locale folders: articles/{locale}/{slug}.html only for priorityLocales unless content_tier=full
Keep CTA soft: help / WhatsApp / demo — never expose internal lead funnel language
Update sitemap.xml with all localized URLs
toneRules: No internal strategy phrases (lead journey, organic intent, soft-sell after help)
Compliance guides: helpful first; TasteIQ POS mentioned lightly or not at all on journey pages
